title: Zero Field Switching (ZFS) Effect in a Nanomagnetic Device
summary: An unexpected phenomenon known as zero field switching (ZFS) could lead to smaller, lower-power memory and computing devices than presently possible. The image shows a layering of platinum (Pt), tungsten (W), and a cobalt-iron-boron magnet (CoFeB)
author: Robin Materese
title_norm: zero field switching zfs effect in a nanomagnetic device
